top_events.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
top_events.label: AfD wins 44% in German state election

top_events.summary: No breakthrough after US envoy talks. War continues in Black Sea region through winter, maintaining security pressure and migration flows affecting Romania.
